theme: Modern hillside luxury mansion with garage, central courtyard, and pool deck

callouts.name: Driveway
callouts.description: Terrorist spawn paved roundabout feeding Garage (West), Courtyard (Mid), and Garden (East).

callouts.name: Court
callouts.description: Counter-Terrorist spawn basketball half-court with decorative hoop leading to Kitchen, Mid, and Pool Deck.

callouts.name: Garage
callouts.description: Bombsite B enclosed luxury car bay with two brush-built sports sedans for plant/defuse cover.

callouts.name: Laundry
callouts.description: West utility connector linking CT Court to Kitchen and Garage Bombsite B.

callouts.name: Kitchen
callouts.description: Key west-side indoor chokepoint connecting Laundry/Garage to Mansion Lounge.

callouts.name: Mansion
callouts.description: Main modern mansion interior lounge overlooking Central Courtyard and linking to Garage.

callouts.name: Vault
callouts.description: North mansion security office connecting T Driveway into Mansion Lounge and Garage.

callouts.name: Balcony
callouts.description: Elevated mansion walkway with wide stairs overlooking Central Courtyard (Ring).

callouts.name: Courtyard
callouts.description: Open central courtyard framed by four pillars and a centerpiece statue pedestal.

callouts.name: Cutout
callouts.description: Central-to-East breach corridor connecting Courtyard (Ring) directly onto Pool Deck.

callouts.name: Garden
callouts.description: Terrorist East approach path with planters leading from Driveway toward Pool and Bombsite A.

callouts.name: Pool
callouts.description: Shallow sunlit swimming pool and patio deck with wide steps on East lane.

callouts.name: Gazebo
callouts.description: Bombsite A covered poolside gazebo and jacuzzi terrace between Pool and CT Court.

callouts.name: Patio Steps
callouts.description: Wide southern archway and steps linking CT Basketball Court into Central Courtyard.
